title: Rabbi Alexandri bar Chanai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious saying of his remains to us in Vayikra Rabbah 19:2: “Rabbi Alexandri bar Chanai [and] Rabbi Alexandri Kerovah said: If all the inhabitants of the world gathered to whiten one wing of a raven, they could not; so too if all the nations of the world gathered to uproot one word of the Torah, they could not.” Yuchasin reads Rabbi Alexandri bar Chagri, and Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11 reads Rabbi Alexandri bar Hadrin and Rabbi Alexandri Kerovah. (The Matnot Kehunah explains: a prayer leader who said piyyutim and kerovetz.)

notes.text: Matnot Kehunah explains Kerovah as a liturgical prayer-leader role. The several patronymics and the separate Alexandri Kerovah remain distinct; קרובץ is not a new person’s name.

The consulted Vayikra Rabbah 19:2 reads Alexandri bar Chagai with a bracketed in-the-name-of before Alexandri Kerovah; Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11 reads bar Hadrin and Alexandri Kerovah. The supplied Chanai and Hyman’s Yuchasin Chagri report remain distinct. The exact Yuchasin and Matnot Kehunah editions have not been independently inspected.
